गये है; और, उक्त अजधजनयम की धारा 20’ड’ की उपधारा (1) के अन सरण में सक्षम प्र ाजधकारी ने अपनी ररपोटि केंरीय सरकार को प्रस्ट् त त कर दी है। अतः अब केंरीय सरकार, सक्षम प्र ाजधकारी से उक्त ररपोटि के प्र ाप्त होने पर और उक्त अजधजनयम की धारा 20’ड’ की उपधारा (1) द्व ारा प्र दत िजक्तयों का प्र योग करते हु ए , यह घोषणा करती है दक इससे उपाबध्द अनसूची में जवजनर्दिष्ट भूजम पूवोक्त प्र योिन के जलए अर्िित की िाएगी। और यह दक केंरीय सरकार उक्त अजधजनयम दक धारा 20’ड’ दक उपधारा (2) के अन सरण में यह घोषणा करती है दक रािपत्र में इस अजधसूचना के प्र काजित होने पर इसमे उपाबध्द अनसूची में जवजनर्दिष्ट भूजम सभी जवलंगमो से म क्त होकर केंरीय सरकार में आतयांदकत रू प से जनजहत हो िाएगी। अनसूची महाराष्ट्र राज्य के “पणे-लोनावला खंड के, गांव- कान्द्हे , तालका-मावल, जिला-पणे में एलसी गेट नंबर 45 के बदले में 2 लेन G197/ROB & LHS/LC No. 45/Kanhe Vlg/20E] अवनीि कमार पाण्डेय , म ख्य प्र िासजनक अजधकारी (जनमािण) MINISTRY OF RAILWAYS (Central Railway) NOTIFICATION Mumbai, the 10th February, 2026 Under clause 20E of the Railway (Amendment) Act 2008 S.O. 705(E).—Whereas, by the notification of the Government of India, in the Ministry of Railways (Railway Board), number, S.O. 4611 (E) dated the 3rd October 2025 published in Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, section 3 Sub-section (ii), dated the 9th October 2025 (hereinafter referred to as the said notification) and issued under sub- section (1) of section 20A of the Railways Act, 1989 (24 of 1989) and Railway (Amendment) Act, 2008 (11 of 2008) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declares its intention to acquire the land specified in the schedule annexed to the said notification for the purpose of execution, maintenance, management and operation of Special Railway Project, namely “Construction of 2 Lane ROB & LHS in lieu of LC gate no. 45, in Village-Kanhe, Tal-Maval, District-Pune of Pune-Lonavla section” in the State of Maharashtra. -- 3 of 5 -- 4 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : EXTRAORDINARY [PART II—SEC. 3(ii)] And whereas, the substance of the said notification was published in daily News Papers "Janpravas (Marathi)" on 5th November 2025, and "Divas-Ratri (Hindi)" on 05th December 2025 by Deputy Collector, Land Acquisition, No.13, Pune, District- Pune, Maharashtra, under sub section (4) of section 20A of the said Act: And whereas, objections has been received; Competent Authority has heard the objections and orders have been passed in terms of section 20D of the said act; And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 20E of the said Act, the Competent Authority has submitted its report to the Central Government; Now therefore, upon receipt of the report of the Competent Authority and in exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 20 E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the lands specified in the schedule annexed hereto shall be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 20 E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that on publication of this notification in the official Gazette, the land specified in the schedule annexed hereto shall vest absolutely in the Central government free from all encumbrances.
